REVIEW & MEASURE

Keep the evidence separate from the guesswork.

Retries: transient failures only, after 15 minutes, up to 3 attempts. Keep the app open and click Retry due checks when available. No background schedule is created. Certificate and policy failures are not retried automatically.

KEEP YOUR LIST CLEAN

Leave the wrong addresses out.

Paste bounced, opted-out, or previously contacted addresses here. Exact matches are suppressed in your results. No Gmail connection is made.

WHAT THE CHECKS MEAN

Evidence, without the guesswork.

1

Format & domain
Checks common email syntax, DNS mail records, duplicates, role addresses, and known disposable domains. The disposable list isn’t exhaustive.

2

Mailbox & catch-all
The local version attempts SMTP recipient checks and tests a random address. Accepted responses are evidence, not delivery guarantees.

3

Unknown stays unknown
Timeouts, greylisting, policy blocks, and inconclusive responses stay unknown. Imported Hunter statuses are labels, not fresh checks.
